lines.t: [Verse 1 - Male]
Pacing around, yeah, you're locking me out
Building a wall out of nothing but doubt
Spitting these words just to see if they stick
Sick of the games and I'm sick of the trick
Your friends are talking, they're whispering loud
They want a show, yeah, we're pleasing the crowd
Everything hurts and it's all just a blur
I am the match and you're the premium blur
[Verse 2 - Female]
Calling me names while you're gripping the wheel
Tell me again how you don't even feel
Look at the mess that you made in the hall
Hoping and praying to see me just fall
The world is a weight and it's pressing right in
Covered in scars and we're covered in sin
Watching us drown while they're throwing us stones
Breaking our spirit and breaking our bones
[Chorus - Duet - Rhythmic and Melodic]
And the world keeps dragging us down, down, down
Chasing a ghost that is running this town
We're just a wreck on a dark dead end
Trying to fix what we can't even mend
Yeah, we're running on empty, we're losing the spark
Tearing each other right up in the dark
No, I can't find it in me
And I can't find it in you
[Verse 3 - Male]
It hit me hard on the edge of the road
3 AM and I'm ready to explode
Crashed to the dirt with my face in the grime
Realized I'm running right out of my time
Screaming to heaven, just losing my mind
Leaving the wreckage and hatred behind
Gave up the fight and I fell to my knees
Asking the Lord for a second of peace
[Verse 4 - Female]
Staring right into a blank bedroom wall
Nobody left for me even to call
Hating the reflection staring at me
Trapped in a prison and losing the key
So I just dropped to the cold bedroom floor
Decided I couldn't do this anymore
Gave all the brokenness up to the sky
Let the Lord take it and let it all die
And the world kept dragging us down, down, down
Until we both hit the dirt where the truth is found
Two broken pieces that'll never fit right
Just tearing each other apart in the night
Yeah, we're running on empty, crying for the truth
But I couldn't find it in me, and I couldn't find it in you
Yeah, we're running on empty, crying for the truth
But I couldn't find it in me, and I couldn't find it in you
[Bridge - Duet]
[Snare rolls building, intimate vocal swap]
He pulled me straight out of the pit
He took the dark and He lit it
We didn't fix what was broken inside
But the Lord met us both where the two roads divide
[Chorus - Duet - Shimmery Pop-Country Anthem]
Now the world can't drag us down, down, down
'Cause we're finally standing on solid ground
He took the pieces that were falling apart
And the Lord put a grace right into this heart
Yeah, we stopped running, found the One who is true
I found my peace in Him...
Yeah, I found Him too
Gave up the fight and I fell to my knees
Asking the Lord for a second of peace
